system.description: • Effect: Once per encounter, when a creature within 60ft casts a spell no higher in level than half your Wizard level, you may try to counter it as your reaction, using no slot: an Intelligence check against its save DC makes it fizzle, and a failure spends the attempt.

activities.name: Counterspell
activities.text: Against the spell's save DC as a reaction; on success a spell of up to half your Wizard level fizzles.
